name: Five-Coordinate Endpoint-Cover Reformulation
statement: Let $\mathcal H\subseteq2^X$ be irredundant, well graded, and union closed, with $|X|=5$, $|\mathcal H|\le11$, and complementary members $A,X\setminus A$. For each coordinate $e$, the contraction $\pi_e(\mathcal H)$ is a learning-space graph exactly when one projected endpoint is a valid root. Therefore all five contractions are learning exactly when the two endpoint repair sets satisfy $\mathcal C_A(\mathcal H)\cup\mathcal C_{X\setminus A}(\mathcal H)=X$.
proof: Each contraction has at most ten states and retains a complementary pair on four coordinates. The sharp endpoint-root bound makes learning equivalent to validity of a projected endpoint. Applying the root-hole contraction-repair criterion coordinate by coordinate turns these alternatives into the displayed union of repair sets.
